raw_report:
## Executive Summary

AlphaFold [1] remains the accuracy benchmark for hard targets, while ESMFold [2] offers faster inference without MSAs. A third review [3] summarizes recent benchmarks.

## Key Differences

AlphaFold [1] emphasizes MSA depth; ESMFold [2] scales via a protein language model.
